title: Sex Determination of Human Nails Based on Attenuated Total Reflection Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy in Forensic Context.
summary: The study measures ATR FT-IR spectra from nails of 63 donors and applies PLS-DA/ANN to the specific forensic question of donor-sex classification. It uses a donor-stratified holdout (11 donors/155 spectra) and reports external-validation AUCs of 0.96 (PLS-DA) and 0.95 (ANN). This is a preliminary forensic analytical result, not population-wide forensic validation.
